title: Instantly Match Your Resume to Millions of Jobs! | Teal's Resume Builder Updates
description:
Take your job application to the next level with Teal's enhanced Resume Builder! In this quick demo, you'll discover powerful new features designed to effortlessly match your resume with millions of job listings. Learn how to instantly identify the right keywords, bookmark exciting opportunities, and seamlessly tailor your resume for every application—all within Teal. Whether you're actively job hunting or casually exploring, these updates make your search efficient and your applications stand out. Watch now to optimize your job search today!

Chapters:

00:00 - Introduction & Resume Builder Updates
00:12 - Using Job Matcher to Compare Jobs
00:59 - Keyword Matching Feature Explained
01:10 - Advanced Job Search within Teal
01:40 - Bookmarking Jobs & Job Tracker
01:58 - Tailoring Your Resume for Specific Jobs
02:20 - Switching Between Jobs in Matcher
02:31 - Closing & Feedback Invitation
